verdict.rationale: Hightouch's REST API is path-versioned: the base URL is https://api.hightouch.com/api/v1, and the published OpenAPI 3.0 spec pins its servers to /api/v1. That shows a versioned API surface. Nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, a changelog, or how breaking changes are communicated, so only half the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, versioning policy explaining the v1 scheme, API changelog or breaking-change notices, independent corroboration of version stability.
